messages.content: Why do we only use 10% of our brains?

response.text: The idea that we only use 10% of our brains is a common myth that has been debunked by neuroscientists. In reality, we use all parts of our brain, although not all at the same time. Different regions of the brain are responsible for different functions, and they work together to carry out various tasks. The myth likely originated from a misinterpretation of early brain research or from self-help books and motivational speakers.
